name: USBee
description:
Glanceable USB and USB-C capability + charging info, powered by usbeehive.

Mounts a Quick Settings tile next to Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and Sound. Shows negotiated charging wattage and link speed in the subtitle, expands to a popover listing every attached USB device and USB-C port with a plain-English diagnostic per port. Reads only from the usbeehive D-Bus daemon (org.usbeehive.Devices5); no /sys access, no subprocesses, no bundled binaries.

When the daemon is missing or out of date, the popover and the preferences window show the relevant setup command with a copy button; pressing it writes that literal command to the clipboard. Nothing else is ever written to the clipboard.

Requires the usbeehive daemon >= 0.10.0 (systemctl --user enable --now usbeehived).
